idea-plugin.name: libSQL / Turso
idea-plugin.description:
Native JDBC driver for libSQL and Turso databases in DataGrip.
  • Full schema introspection — tables appear in the database tree
  • Proper query lifecycle — no hanging spinners
  • DBMS detected as SQLite/libSQL
  • Connects via the libSQL HTTP pipeline API
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.17.0
  • Auto-registers in DataGrip driver list — no manual setup needed
  • Auth token via Password field, securely stored and URL-decoded for JWT
  • Fat JAR with shaded Gson for isolated driver classloader
  • Turso brand icon
  • Clear error messages for auth failures (401/403)
  • Debug logging to $TMPDIR/libsql-driver.log
0.1.0
  • Initial JDBC driver: connect, query, schema introspection via HTTP pipeline API
